name: Automated PR Bot Review & WorkItem Delivery Pack
description: End-to-end delivery playbook: reacts to Hub bot-blocked PR events via a durable T3 Workflow and teaches coding agents to verify WorkItem ACs and sync Pulses.
author: u3code

defaultDirectives: Keep PRs focused and under 500 changed lines whenever possible.
Never auto-merge directly into release branches without human approval.
Always verify WorkItem acceptance criteria before requesting QA sign-off.

workflows.name: bot-review-autofix
workflows.description: Triggered by Hub automation-relay webhook on pr.bot_blocked; investigates bot findings, runs fixes, asks human approval, and publishes a Team Hub pulse.

skills.name: workitem-delivery
skills.description: Guides coding agents to read Team Hub WorkItem specs/directives, verify ACs via MCP, and publish concise Pulses.
